photos.c:
Micky Pyer (extreme left) lines up at the start of the Belgrave 10 mile C.C. Championship in 1926. Having won the title in 1923 and 1924, this time he had to give way to his captain Bert Footer.
Left to right: A.D.Pyer, A.E.Smith, -, J.G.Flatt, -, -, -, -, H.E.Footer, W.L.Bayliss, G.Still.

share.d: Adam Smith in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1989–1991: 3 mentions in 2 issues and 1 photograph.
